prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1197; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the claimant reporting a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant states the other vehicle entered the intersection against the light and struck the driver's side. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and was transported by ambulance. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant to confirm the account of the collision. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says they have not yet spoken to anyone about settlement. Explained the claims process, the rental vehicle coverage under the policy, and the option to get medical records sent to the file. Claimant agreed to sign medical authorization.

Entry 3: Received the responding officer's report. It notes both vehicles had visible damage consistent with a side impact, with the at-fault driver cited for failing to yield. Two independent witnesses listed in the report. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to the file.

Entry 4: Claimant provided orthopedic records showing a fracture of the wrist, treated with a splint and follow-up visits. Treatment is ongoing and a specialist evaluation is scheduled. Noted the claimant is off work and requested wage documentation. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the bodily injury component.

Entry 5: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability position. Carrier acknowledged the citation and indicated liability is likely to be accepted, pending review of the injury documentation. Claimant advised of the status and told a further update will follow once the treating physician's report is received. File remains open.
